title: The Loyalty War
description: Two rival taco trucks share one curb and one regular. Donna and Marco are here to settle whose punch card is real, and Steve has been double-dipping the whole time.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: You're on Snazzie FM. Tonight, two of our finest food trucks have a small disagreement about a parking spot, and we are going to be very mature about it. Donna, Marco, welcome.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: It's a curb. They're fighting over a curb.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: It's a beloved curb, Barry. Donna, you've been on that corner how long?

lines.speaker: caller-donna
lines.text: Eleven years, Ronnie. Eleven years, that corner is mine. Then in March, this man parks his little truck eight inches off my bumper.

lines.speaker: caller-marco
lines.text: It's a public street, Donna. Public.

lines.speaker: caller-donna
lines.text: Eight inches, Marco! I can smell your cilantro through my serving window!

lines.speaker: caller-marco
lines.text: That's a compliment, technically.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Okay, but it's the same food, right? You both sell tacos?

lines.speaker: caller-donna
lines.text: It is NOT the same food, Barry.

lines.speaker: caller-marco
lines.text: It's exactly the same food. She copied my menu.

lines.speaker: caller-donna
lines.text: I copied YOURS? <p:0.3> Ronnie, he copied my loyalty card. Buy nine tacos, the tenth is free. That was my idea. Mine.

lines.speaker: caller-marco
lines.text: Everybody does buy nine get one free, Donna. That's not an invention, that's just being a person.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Now that does seem like a common arrangement.

lines.speaker: caller-donna
lines.text: He copied the STAMP, Ronnie. My stamp is a little smiling taco. His is a little smiling taco. <p:0.3> Same smile.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: How do you copy a smile?

lines.speaker: caller-marco
lines.text: You don't, Barry. My taco is winking. Big difference.

lines.speaker: caller-steve
lines.text: Yeah, hi, longtime listener. So I actually have both cards?

lines.speaker: caller-donna
lines.text: [surprise-oh] Steve?

lines.speaker: caller-marco
lines.text: Steve, is that you?

lines.speaker: caller-steve
lines.text: Hey, guys. Yeah. So I been getting nine stamps on Donna's card, and nine stamps on Marco's card, kinda at the same time?

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: He's playing both sides.

lines.speaker: caller-donna
lines.text: Steve, you told me I was your corner.

lines.speaker: caller-marco
lines.text: He told ME I was his corner!

lines.speaker: caller-steve
lines.text: I mean, you're both kinda my corner? It's one corner. You're eight inches apart.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: He makes a fair point. It is a shared corner.

lines.speaker: caller-donna
lines.text: So which card hit ten first, Steve? Whose tenth taco did you redeem?

lines.speaker: caller-steve
lines.text: Uh. Well. <p:0.3> Neither, actually.

lines.speaker: caller-marco
lines.text: Neither?

lines.speaker: caller-steve
lines.text: Donna's machine ate the card at stamp nine. Said it needed a tenth stamp to give me the free one. But the free one IS the tenth. So.

lines.speaker: caller-donna
lines.text: ...That's a glitch. We're aware of the glitch.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Wait, so nobody's ever actually gotten a free taco?

lines.speaker: caller-marco
lines.text: Mine works perfectly, Barry.

lines.speaker: caller-steve
lines.text: Marco's wanted a tenth stamp too.

lines.speaker: caller-marco
lines.text: [dissatisfaction-hnn] That's a different glitch.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: So to be clear, the free taco, on either card, requires a stamp that does not exist.

lines.speaker: caller-donna
lines.text: The tenth stamp is conceptual, Ronnie.

lines.speaker: caller-marco
lines.text: Mine's aspirational.

lines.speaker: caller-steve
lines.text: I got like forty cards, man. I got a shoebox. Forty cards, all stuck on nine.

lines.speaker: caller-donna
lines.text: Forty? Steve, you've been to Marco's twenty times!

lines.speaker: caller-marco
lines.text: And you've been to Donna's twenty times, you traitor!

lines.speaker: caller-steve
lines.text: I'm chasing the free one, guys! I'm in deep!

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: He's spent four hundred dollars chasing a free taco that doesn't exist.

lines.speaker: caller-donna
lines.text: He could've just BOUGHT the tenth taco, Barry!

lines.speaker: caller-marco
lines.text: Buy the taco, Steve!

lines.speaker: caller-donna
lines.text: Just buy the taco!

lines.speaker: caller-steve
lines.text: Then it's not FREE!

lines.speaker: caller-marco
lines.text: Move your truck, Donna!

lines.speaker: caller-donna
lines.text: Move YOUR truck!

lines.speaker: caller-steve
lines.text: Stamp my card!

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Ronnie, they're all yelling about a stamp that isn't real.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: That's the beauty of loyalty, Barry. <p:0.3> Nobody's ever getting the free taco. They just keep coming back.

lines.speaker: caller-steve
lines.text: ...Wait. So I'm never getting it?

lines.speaker: caller-donna
lines.text: We'll see you tomorrow, Steve.

lines.speaker: caller-marco
lines.text: Bring both cards.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Two trucks, one curb, forty cards, zero free tacos. <p:0.3> That's just good neighboring. We'll be right back.
